reviews.title: Calm, no guilt, and a real reset.
reviews.body: We spent months negotiating every night and blaming each other. The New-Body Closet ended the negotiation. It is not magic — some nights are still hard — but nobody has to ask, and that was the whole problem.
reviews.name: Ife

reviews.title: The decision tree saved us at 2am.
reviews.body: What I needed was not more information. I needed a default that holds when we are tired — and a way to recover after a bad night without guilt. This gave us both.
reviews.name: Kemi

reviews.title: Finally felt like a team again.
reviews.body: I can see how the new-body closet works when life cooperates. Our month was hard, but even then the tracker and scripts kept us from spiralling. With a calmer month it would have been even better.
reviews.name: Fatima

reviews.title: Every module earned its place.
reviews.body: We went from Googling at 3am to checking one chart on the fridge. Both adults see it, both follow it. The argument stopped before it started.
reviews.name: Sade

reviews.title: The scripts did what I could not say.
reviews.body: The New-Body Closet is what I wish discharge instructions had been: one house rule, one routine, one card for when it looks wrong.
reviews.name: Halima

reviews.title: Clear, kind, and actually doable.
reviews.body: The system is solid. It gave us a clear next step. We finally had a default that worked even when exhausted.
reviews.name: Hauwa

reviews.title: The tracker gave us proof, not just feelings.
reviews.body: The New-Body Closet is practical. It replaces asking with a pre-agreed default. We hit the bad-night protocol twice and having a reset instead of a meltdown — mine — is the part I did not know I needed.
reviews.name: Grace

reviews.title: No more Googling at 3am.
